Diffuse only -- this surface is the plaza path, mostly seen from a
distance and an oblique angle, where a normal map earns its payload far
less than it does on the floor/wall interiors. Vendored file
(diffuse.webp) is the above original resized 1k -> 512x512 and
re-encoded as WebP (POLISH.md item 5: "texture payload modest") -- a
lossy transform of a CC0 asset, not a distinct work, done for file size
only. Re-download and verify the MD5 above to check the original if
this ever needs redoing.

No attribution is legally required under CC0, but it's recorded here
for provenance -- this is a real, deliberately-chosen asset, not a
placeholder.
